title: Households per 1 km cell
unit: households per 1 km cell (a count, not a 0-1 index)
direction: 1 = the off-grid solar market has failed to arrive (non-grid households are mostly unserved); 0 = the market has quietly succeeded (non-grid households are mostly on solar). Higher value = more need and more unmet demand. The challenge brief did not fix a direction, so check it before mixing this layer with EAE layers that run the other way.
no_data: -9999. Cells with no prediction (missing feature, or own population below 1 per km2) and cells where the non-grid share is below 0.2 (the ratio is unstable there).
confidence: LOW. Treat as a hypothesis about where the off-grid solar market has not arrived, not a finding. SYNTHETIC DEMO DATA: made up by src/make_demo_data.py to show that the pipeline runs. It is not Rwanda, not DHS data, and the numbers mean nothing for any real place.
use_with: demo_do_not_trust.tif (flag codes: 1 widest ranges, 2 features outside the survey range, 3 both).
method: Population (WorldPop 2020) scaled so the cells hold 114,668 households (national count of the demo); unserved households = households x predicted unserved share. Not EAE-normalised: use it to size need, and the market-reality layer to rank.
limitations: SYNTHETIC DEMO DATA: made up by src/make_demo_data.py to show that the pipeline runs. It is not Rwanda, not DHS data, and the numbers mean nothing for any real place.
